signatures: class Query: __init__(self, columns, table, where, group_by, order_by, limit)
Query.columns: list  # ('column', name) | ('agg', func_lower, argname, alias)
Query.where: object  # predicate tree or None
notes: SELECT <cols> FROM <table> [WHERE <expr>] [GROUP BY <cols>] [ORDER BY <col> [ASC|DESC], ...] [LIMIT <n>]. '*' becomes [('column','*')]. Aggregate FUNC(arg) [AS alias] becomes ('agg', func_lowercase, arg, alias) with default alias f'{func_lowercase}({arg})'; COUNT(*) gives arg '*'. where-tree node shapes: ('cmp', name, op, literal), ('and', l, r), ('or', l, r), ('not', child); precedence tightest first NOT, AND, OR; ops '=', '!=', '<', '<=', '>', '>='. Malformed input raises ValueError. Depends only on tinyq.lexer.tokenize/Token.
